description: This Java source file defines the ShareeListAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView adapter used in an Android application to display a list of sharing options, including internal shares, external links, and email shares within a file sharing context.

classes.name: ShareeListAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for managing and displaying a list of share objects (OCShare) in a RecyclerView, including different share types such as internal, public link, email, and a placeholder for new public links.

methods.name: ShareeListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with activity context, list of shares, listener, and account. It sorts the shares and sets stable IDs.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for the item at the specified position based on the share's type.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder for the share type based on viewType.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder based on the share at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns unique ID for the share at the given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of shares.

methods.name: addShares
methods.description: Adds a list of shares to the adapter, removing duplicates and sorting.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific share from the list.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all shares from the list.

methods.name: addShare
methods.description: Adds a new share to the top of the list.

methods.name: updateShare
methods.description: Updates an existing share in the list based on ID.

methods.name: sortShares
methods.description: Sorts shares, prioritizing links and email shares on top, internal shares at the bottom.

methods.name: getShares
methods.description: Returns the current list of shares.

methods.name: removeNewPublicShare
methods.description: Removes any share of type NEW_PUBLIC_LINK from the list.
